exposure: misoprostol only group vs. combined misoprostol plus Foley catheter group
cohort: Women in their late second trimester of pregnancy with previous multiple cesarean sections.
finding: The combination of low dose vaginal misoprostol and Foley catheter is an effective and safe method for termination of second trimester pregnancy in women with previous multiple cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The combination of low-dose vaginal misoprostol and a Foley catheter was found to be effective and safe for second-trimester pregnancy termination in women with previous multiple cesarean sections.
